settings.eyebrow: Why adult cleanses aren’t for kids
settings.heading: Kids aren’t small adults
settings.steps:
Kids’ tummies are smaller and more sensitive than ours.
Most herbal cleanses are made for adults: adult doses, bitter, and often made with alcohol.
So kids spit them out, and mums are right to be wary.
A kids’ formula needs three things: gentle herbs at a kid’s dose, a taste they’ll accept, and nothing nasty.
That’s exactly how Para Patrol™ is made: 11 herbal extracts including fennel, anise and thyme, raspberry flavour, no alcohol, no sugar, for ages 3+. One dropper in juice.

settings.eyebrow: The chemist tablet vs daily support
settings.heading: Two different jobs
settings.intro: The chemist tablet has its place. Para Patrol™ does a different job.

How it’s taken | A tablet or chewable dose | One raspberry dropper in juice
Made for | Adults and kids (check the pack) | Kids 3+
Where to start | Your pharmacist or GP | Alongside your GP’s advice
settings.note: If you’ve seen worms, see your pharmacist or GP first. Para Patrol™ is for the everyday tummy support in between.

Fennel seed extract | A gentle seed traditionally used for little tummies.
Thyme leaf extract | An everyday kitchen herb used in traditional herbal blends.
Whole clove extract | A familiar kitchen spice used in traditional herbal blends.
Aloe vera | A plant traditionally used for tummy comfort.
Oregano leaf extract | A kitchen herb used in traditional herbal blends.
Black walnut hull extract | A traditional botanical. It’s a tree nut, so not for kids with a tree nut allergy.
Wormwood herb extract | A traditional bitter herb, used as a small part of the blend.
Pau d’arco bark extract | A South American bark used in traditional herbal blends.
Pumpkin seed extract | A food-based ingredient (yes, the same seeds).
